cards.stem: In the example at 35000 feet what distance to the center of the earth is given
cards.quote: If an airplane is flying at 35000 feet (about 7 miles) the distance to the center of the earth is about 4007 miles.
cards.hint: Add the flight height to the surface radius

cards.stem: What value is listed for gravitational acceleration at the surface in metric units
cards.quote: On the surface of the earth, its value is 9.8 meters per square second or 32.2 feet per square second.
cards.hint: Look for the metric value paired with feet per second value

cards.stem: In the test case how much does an airplane weighing 10000 pounds on the surface weigh at 35000 feet
cards.hint: Weight drops a small amount with height

cards.stem: What result is given for the square of 4000 over 4007 in the altitude change calculation
cards.quote: We can calculate the change in the gravitational constant as the square of (4000/4007) which equals .9965.
